title: Deutsche Telekom Future-Proofs Its Mobile for Microsoft Teams Service with AudioCodes
summary: How did Deutsche Telekom use AudioCodes SBCs to safeguard its Mobile for Microsoft Teams service and ensure 3GPP compliance? Find out here!
body_markdown:
Future-proofing mobile voice in the UC era. Discover how Deutsche Telekom partnered with AudioCodes to seamlessly replace a critical component in its Mobile for Microsoft Teams service, delivering uninterrupted connectivity, strict compliance and a scalable foundation for next-generation enterprise communications.


## A Global Leader in Telecommunications


Deutsche Telekom is one of the world’s leading telecom providers, headquartered in Germany and operating in over 50 countries. The company acts as a trusted digitalization partner for its business customers, delivering advanced connectivity, cloud and collaboration solutions to organizations of all sizes.


## Ensuring Service Continuity During Platform Transition


Deutsche Telekom’s Mobile for Microsoft Teams service lets businesses use their mobile number directly inside Teams, making it easy to manage calls and communications across devices. Behind the scenes, it’s powered by a tightly integrated setup linking the mobile network, Teams and automated provisioning systems.


When Microsoft’s Perimeta session border controller (SBC) approached end-of-life, Deutsche Telekom needed a fast replacement – without disrupting live customers. That meant rolling out a fully compliant, next-gen solution under tight deadlines, while keeping everything running smoothly.


The challenge was significant. Ensure zero service impact, maintain existing workflows and deliver a future-ready platform with advanced 3GPP capabilities, high reliability and room for ongoing innovation.


## Seamless SBC-Based Modernization for Teams Phone Mobile


AudioCodes was chosen to deliver the new solution, bringing deep expertise in Microsoft UC and decades of telecom experience. The goal was clear – to fully replace Perimeta while maintaining seamless service for Deutsche Telekom’s customers.


From day one, AudioCodes worked closely with Deutsche Telekom to define exactly what needed to be replicated and where improvements could be made. Drawing on strong experience with Teams Phone Mobile, the team enhanced its SBC firmware to meet strict 3GPP requirements while fitting smoothly into Deutsche Telekom’s existing environment.


The solution is built on AudioCodes[Mediant Cloud Edition SBCs](https://www.audiocodes.com/products/session-border-controllers-sbcs/mediant-ce-sbc) , a software-based solution certified for Microsoft Teams, and was deployed across multiple sites for high availability and resilience. These SBCs handle signaling and media between the mobile network and Microsoft Teams, while AudioCodes[One Voice Operations Center (OVOC)](https://www.audiocodes.com/products/management-products-solutions/one-voice-operations-center) provides real-time monitoring, provisioning and lifecycle management of the SBC infrastructure.


Despite tight timelines, AudioCodes delivered quickly without cutting corners. Close collaboration throughout design, testing and rollout ensured fast issue resolution and a smooth, reliable deployment aligned with Deutsche Telekom’s operational needs.


> *“AudioCodes proved to be an exceptionally reliable and knowledgeable partner, delivering a 3GPP-compliant solution under intense time pressure without impacting our live service. Their deep expertise in Microsoft Teams telephony and rapid development capability were critical to ensuring the continuity and future readiness of our Mobile for Microsoft Teams service.”*
>
>
> **André Rink, System Architect, Deutsche Telekom**


## Uninterrupted Service and a Future-Ready Foundation


By deploying AudioCodes’ SBC-based solution, Deutsche Telekom secured the future of its Mobile for Microsoft Teams service while staying fully 3GPP compliant beyond Perimeta’s end-of-life. Just as importantly, this was achieved without any disruption to existing customers.


Even under an aggressive schedule, the project was delivered on time, highlighting AudioCodes’ ability to execute complex infrastructure projects under pressure. The migration was seamless, with no service interruptions, configuration changes or impact on quality, ensuring a consistent experience for business users.


With the new architecture in place, Deutsche Telekom now has a strong, future-ready foundation. Backed by AudioCodes’ expertise and close collaboration, the company can confidently continue evolving its Teams-based mobile services and delivering advanced, integrated communication experiences.


###


Deutsche Telekom deployed AudioCodes[Mediant Cloud Edition SBCs](https://www.audiocodes.com/products/session-border-controllers-sbcs/mediant-ce-sbc) to replace a retiring platform component, maintaining uninterrupted service for enterprise customers while meeting strict 3GPP requirements. AudioCodes[One Voice Operations Center (OVOC)](https://www.audiocodes.com/products/management-products-solutions/one-voice-operations-center) provides real-time monitoring, provisioning and lifecycle management of the SBC infrastructure.


###


AudioCodes brought deep Microsoft Teams telephony and telecommunications expertise, enabling rapid development of a 3GPP-compliant SBC solution that integrated seamlessly with Deutsche Telekom’s existing provisioning environment.


###


The new architecture delivered high availability, redundancy and uninterrupted Teams Phone Mobile service, while creating a scalable foundation for future service growth and innovation.
